dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, thick-walled 'O' and 'C' shaped light-intensity rings are visible across the dorsal and lateral regions. These structures exhibit a sharp contrast transition from dark-grey exterior boundaries to lighter-grey interior regions, notably an elongated oval structure on the upper spinal line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters concentrated on the neck and anterior dorsal area. These clusters are asymmetrical and lack an internal gradient, appearing as a dense field of non-uniform speckles.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent 'O' rings on the dorsal mid-section form a scalene triangle. A secondary cluster of four high-intensity blobs on the lateral shoulder forms an irregular quadrilateral.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct dark-toned mark or potential lesion located below the right ocular region. An irregular dark indentation is also visible on the dorsal surface of the snout.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent dark-toned facial mask pattern encircling the eyes and muzzle, contrasting sharply with the lighter mottled textures on the surrounding neck and head.
